name: Monitor Workspaces
author: risent
description: A monitor-aware workspace indicator for the Omarchy bar

barWidget.description: Shows each monitor's active workspace independently

schema.label: Indicator style
schema.description: Visual treatment for the workspace displayed on this monitor.

schema.label: Always-visible workspaces
schema.description: Always show workspace numbers starting at 1; other active or persistent workspaces are added automatically.

schema.label: Maximum workspace number
schema.description: Ignore numbered workspaces above this value.

schema.label: Workspace names
schema.description: Comma-separated number:name pairs, e.g. 1:chrome, 2:code. Named workspaces show as "1: chrome" on horizontal bars.

schema.label: Maximum name length
schema.description: Longer workspace names are shortened with an ellipsis.
